topic: Someone receives a package intended for the previous tenant
text: I received a package today, addressed not to me, but to the person who once called this place home. As I held the box, its weight a small mystery, I considered my options. I could have simply discarded it, or left it for someone else to deal with. But no, I decided to take a different path. I've made a few inquiries, tracking down the rightful owner. It's a small act, perhaps, but it feels right. After all, in a world where so much is impersonal and rushed, taking the time to do what's correct can be its own reward. I'll see to it that this package finds its way to the hands it was meant for.
